provider: Google for Startups Cloud Program (Start / Scale tiers)

free_tier.stated: Our Funded program tiers (Scale, and Scale AI) range from $200K - $350k in credits, and are designed for growing startups with verifiable Pre-Seed to Series A funding.

retention.notes: The startup page states no credit expiry period. It says program qualifications change annually and enrollment in a previous year does not guarantee re-enrollment or eligibility for the current year.

egress.terms: Cloud Storage free tier: 100 GB per month of outbound transfer from North America to all region destinations (excluding China and Australia), in us-east1, us-west1 and us-central1 only. Beyond it, egress is not addressed on the startup page.

tooling: rclone backend 'gcs' (Tier 1), gsutil, GCS XML/JSON API, GCS interop keys give an S3-compatible endpoint.
chaining: Credits may only be used by the original applicant and cannot be shared, split, or resold. A startup that did not use its credits in a previous enrollment may still be eligible if it meets all in-year eligibility requirements. Funded tiers (Scale, Scale AI) are $200K - $350k; the Start tier is $2k. No credit expiry is stated on the page.
limits_note: Per-object-cap: GCS single-object max 5 TiB. The startup page excludes educational institutions, government entities, nonprofits, personal blogs or content, dev shops, and consultancies or agencies.

identity_cost.detail: A company-domain email address that matches the company website domain, and a Google Cloud billing account ID owned by a user on that domain. Whether a card is needed is unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: Requires a funded company, a matching domain email and a billing account owned by that domain; credits land in a specific billing account ID and cannot be moved afterwards. Year-over-year re-enrolment is not guaranteed.
confidence_note: the startup page states the funded-tier credit range of $200K-$350k
